sentences.text:
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.5230 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in FIR.No.466 of 2020, dated 05.11.2020 on the file of Mangalagiri Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C.") and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act").

Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

_ _ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date : 17.11.2020 Gvl HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION No.5230 of 2020 Date : 17.11.2020 Gvl Annam Sri Ramaiah vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 17 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62441100/
